task: F32 CI cross-workflow PR-origin verification without accepting any push canary or non-equivalent proof

assuranceCeiling.rationale: A source-branch push canary cannot substitute for an exact-base PR producer. This bounded selector fixes custody and leaves browser, runtime and Product Owner acceptance gates independently authoritative.

acceptanceCriteria: An exact-head, exact-base, open same-repository PR is required before resolving a Factory producer.
Only a successful exact matching pull_request run may supply external completion proof.
Push canaries, closed PRs, foreign repositories and stale or missing PR/base/run metadata fail closed.
All exact-head governance, source regression and build gates remain mandatory.
invariants: CI plan base SHA matches the current PR base SHA.
Workflow producer metadata independently agrees with the selected open PR context.
Product Owner approval cannot be inferred from source proof selection.
forbiddenStates: Push canary becomes a trusted 42/42 external acceptance artifact.
A stale base or foreign PR is accepted as exact source authority.
Missing producer metadata silently falls back to weaker evidence.

failureModes: Push-run preference masks successful full PR producer.
Head-only matching ignores PR base drift.
A closed or foreign PR impersonates current source authority.
No authorized PR exists but CI silently falls back to canary.
edgeCases: F31 head on exact F30 base with both push and PR runs.
Same SHA on multiple base branches.
Missing producer pull_requests array and future pending run.

alternatives.summary: Use an independent release-scoped helper to authorize only exact PR workflow producer evidence.
alternatives.reason: Preserves the existing manifest and PO validators and repairs only the producer selection root cause.

alternatives.summary: Accept a successful push canary as complete external approval.
alternatives.reason: A push canary contains incomplete browser and provenance data, so it would weaken truth.

alternatives.summary: Hardcode a historical full producer run identifier.
alternatives.reason: A static run becomes invalid on any future source or base change and lacks reusable canonical identity.

specialistReviews.finding: Head-only matching permits proof to cross PR base and repository boundaries.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require immutable pair of base/head, current open PR state and matching producer metadata.

specialistReviews.finding: The source-branch resolver wrongly prefers its push canary.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use exact open PR producer and retain independently validated manifest contract.

specialistReviews.finding: Unnecessary reruns of visual proof are costly and do not cure the selector's faulty event authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Isolate release source fix and avoid Vercel/Supabase writes.

challenge.finding: The resolver accepts an incomplete visual proof.
challenge.resolution: Never accept a producer without pull_request event provenance.

challenge.finding: Head-only evidence may refer to an old review context.
challenge.resolution: Recheck current and producer base SHA against active plan.

challenge.scenario: Another repository uses the same branch name.
challenge.finding: Loose PR search could accept a foreign source.
challenge.resolution: Require both head and base repositories match current repository.

challenge.finding: An obsolete PR could appear in historical run metadata.
challenge.resolution: Require a live open PR lookup before run selection.

challenge.finding: A permissive fallback could resurrect the canary bug.
challenge.resolution: Return no authorized candidates and explicit failure.

challenge.scenario: Full browser cases pass without PO journey.
challenge.finding: A valid external run still does not prove a new candidate's acceptance.
challenge.resolution: Preserve F31's downstream handoffReady checks and PO blockers.

proofPlan: Pin F31 parent HEAD, stage bounded release-only source unit and keep original F31 draft unchanged.
Test exact PR selection and all negative context mismatches in source Vitest suite.
Check remotely executed Plan Before Code, known failure replay, Reference/Implementation Sync, TypeScript and CI.
Leave unproven Factory PO journey blocked and do not merge or deploy.

semanticExecutionRoute.request: F32 CI exact open PR producer evidence

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The CI resolver selects a successful but incomplete push canary instead of the successful PR Factory proof for the exact same HEAD, resulting in a spurious evidence and lifecycle blockage.
observableOutcomes: Current open native-repository PR identity is verified by branch, head SHA and base SHA.
Producer proof comes only from matching pull_request workflow-run metadata, never a push event.
Failures remain explicit and all existing downstream manifest, runtime and PO gates are retained.
unresolvedRisks: The parent F31 Factory candidate identity, showroom and PO journey remain not approved.
A new commit or base change invalidates exact-context evidence until reverified.

in: immutable PR provenance helper and tests

requirements.requirement: A successful Factory source may be selected only from exact-head, exact-base current same-repository open PR producer evidence; never from push canary.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Push canary and unpinned PR metadata cannot masquerade as full Factory completion evidence.

notes:
F32 independent release-infrastructure source transaction stacked on F31 PR #1236. Does not claim Factory visual or PO approval. Exact head/base GitHub identity, CI gates and no production changes.
Exact-head Plan Before Code validated: docs/architecture is canonical knowledge-infrastructure, therefore F32 deliberately requires FULL global + Template Factory known-failure replay (49 failure IDs). Expected failure IDs and guard digest are taken from remote gate diagnostics; no failures or gates are waived.
